headlines.title: Latest News In E-Commerce - Shopify's Revenue Surge Highlights Evolving Market Dynamics
headlines.summary: The e-commerce industry continues to witness substantial growth, as demonstrated by Shopify's latest financial results. Shopify reported a 32% increase in revenue and a 22% free cash flow margin for the quarter ending September 30, 2026, highlighting the strength of its business model and expanding addressable market. With $119 billion powered in Gross Merchandise Volume (GMV), Shopify is effectively integrating commerce across multiple platforms and channels.

headlines.title: Shopify (SHOP) Stock Climbs As Q3 Earnings Back Premium Valuation
headlines.summary: Shopify walked into this Q3 2026 print with a premium story and a premium price tag, and the first trading verdict was clear. The stock jumped 7.4% on Wednesday to about US$153, as traders responded to another set of strong ecommerce numbers. The headline is simple. Gross merchandise value reached US$119b and quarterly revenue hit US$3.7b, while free cash flow ran at a 22% margin.

headlines.title: GOFO Announces Real-Time Delivery Tracking Integration With Shopify
headlines.summary: GOFO, a technology-driven last-mile delivery carrier, today announced a new integration with Shopify that will bring GOFO delivery visibility more directly into the commerce experience used by merchants and shoppers.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
